title: Market scan: model offering parity and differentiation framework
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Objective: Produce a living competitive analysis and model landscape tracker that helps product, engineering, and go-to-market prioritize roadmap items for the next two quarters. Scope includes managed API offerings, open-source model ecosystems, on-prem/private deployments, pricing shapes (per-token, per-embedding, reserved capacity), and feature parity for production features (streaming, function calling, embeddings, fine-tuning/adapter support, quantized variants).
acceptance_criteria: A single canonical spreadsheet (Drive) with normalized rows for 20+ vendors and 40+ model variants updated with architecture, max context, quantization support, streaming, function-calling, embeddings, pricing tier, SLA options, and private deployment support
An executive one-pager summarizing top 5 competitive risks and 6 actionable product moves (prioritized with RICE)
A public-facing model catalog template draft for Redwood Console modeled on gaps found (fields + UX copy)
Presentation to GTM and Eng with recommended experiments and two pilot partners for private deployment proof points
deliverables: Living model landscape spreadsheet (Drive link in links)
Competitive heatmap PDF (feature parity vs. Redwood)
timeline: Week 1: inventory and normalization; Week 2: deep interviews and pricing modeling; Week 3: synthesize heatmap and recommendations; Week 4: reviews and GTM presentation
